newsitem.title: USA: CBOT to ask for inflation-indexed Treasury futures.
newsitem.headline: CBOT to ask for inflation-indexed Treasury futures.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) will announce plans Wednesday to ask regulators for permission to launch futures and futures-options based on the U.S. Treasury's new inflation-indexed debt securities.

"We're going to move forward and ask the CFTC to (let us) do the corresponding futures and futures-options," a CBOT official said Tuesday. The CBOT late Tuesday set a press conference for Wednesday morning to unveil the plan.

Treasury on Wednesday will sell $7 billion worth of inflation-protected 10-year T-notes, its first sale of index-linked U.S. government debt securities. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
